mil7.5.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, undurassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.5.3:1.2: Yathā mahārāja unduro ito c' ito ca vicaranto āhārūpasiṃsako yeva carati,
mil7.5.3:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ito c' ito ca vicarantena yoniso manasikārūpasiṃsaken' eva bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.5.3:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja undurassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.3:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Upasenena Vangantaputtena:
